cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import compiler

random.seed(11)
N = 48
PARTS = list(range(32))
ORD = list(range(32, 48))
links = []; seen = set()
def add(u, v):
    key = (min(u, v), max(u, v))
    if key in seen or u == v: return
    seen.add(key); links.append((u, v))
for i in range(len(ORD)):
    add(ORD[i], ORD[(i + 1) % len(ORD)])
for p in PARTS:
    add(p, ORD[p % len(ORD)])
    add(p, ORD[(p * 7 + 3) % len(ORD)])
demands = {p: random.randrange(1, 6) for p in PARTS}
envelope = {i: 5 for i in range(len(links))}
period = 4
caps = {l: period * r for l, r in envelope.items()}
cut, deficit = compiler.find_deficient_cut(N, links, caps, PARTS, demands)
inside = set(cut)
print('cut size', len(cut))
print('cut', sorted(cut))
print('participants in cut', sorted(set(cut) & set(PARTS)))
print('demand in cut', sum(demands[v] for v in PARTS if v in inside), 'total demand', sum(demands.values()))
cross = 0; cl = []
for l, rate in caps.items():
    u, w = links[l]
    if (u in inside) != (w in inside):
        cross += rate; cl.append((l, u, w))
print('cross', cross, 'crosslinks', cl[:10], '...')
PYEOF
